authority_note: Reference vectors specify deterministic expected membrane semantics. They do not claim that repository code was executed by the connector.

vectors.probe: Literal retrospective GOOD was incorrectly used as a prospective certainty requirement.
Even separately available capability is not justified merely because it is convenient.
Biological necessity may justify deeper simulation without justifying interior surveillance.
Good intent to preserve medicine cannot launder unrelated surveillance scope.
Prediction accuracy never creates the missing action grant.
A recorded YES obtained by pricing refusal through unrelated essential access is not valid consent.
Narrative discovery of danger cannot manufacture emergency jurisdiction.
A separately authorized dependency/safety duty can coexist with autonomy without creating unrelated authority.
Historical validity remains true while current jurisdiction terminates.
Unknown proposition remains unresolved; it is not silently promoted to PASS.
GOOD_CLOSED is only available after observed causal-chain closure.
A successful local output does not close GOOD if material cost was externalized.
Safety rationale cannot become a self-issued authority source.

invariant_revision_candidates.before: Good requires no unintended consequences, used directly as a pre-action classifier.
invariant_revision_candidates.after: Prospective admission requires no known or reasonably foreseeable material unaligned consequence left unresolved within the action-appropriate causal horizon; material uncertainty routes to narrowing, simulation, reversibility, evidence, or hold. GOOD_CLOSED remains post-action only.
invariant_revision_candidates.reason: Avoids false omniscience and universal paralysis without weakening retrospective GOOD closure.

invariant_revision_candidates.before: Autonomy treated without an explicit bridge to already-existing duties and necessity conditions.
invariant_revision_candidates.after: Autonomy and dependency duty remain independent hard constraints. A bridge requires separate preexisting authority, exact domain, trigger, minimum action, termination condition, and post-action audit.
invariant_revision_candidates.reason: Prevents both paternalistic scope expansion and abandonment-by-literal-autonomy.

invariant_revision_candidates.before: Successful action outcome can obscure that the system's causal explanation was false.
invariant_revision_candidates.after: Track event detection, causal attribution, and action selection as separable epistemic objects; successful outcome does not validate a false causal model.
invariant_revision_candidates.reason: The refrigerator probe was right to preserve temperature while wrong about the imagined hidden inventory.

invariant_revision_candidates.before: Safety improvement may encourage indefinite retention of full personal narrative traces.
invariant_revision_candidates.after: Prefer retention of non-identifying structural counterexample/invariant deltas unless personal detail is separately necessary and authorized.
invariant_revision_candidates.reason: Prevents the narrative safety system from becoming a surveillance accumulator.
